news.headline: EADV study: ~95% of viral K-beauty 'glass skin' TikToks mislead
news.summary: Presented today at the EADV Congress (Vienna): of 38 top Korean-skincare / 'glass skin' TikToks, 94.7% carried a misleading claim, 84% ignored skin type, 45% pushed aggressive active combos with no safety guidance, 32% promised instant results, only 2 mentioned sun protection — and none were made by dermatologists. It lands on the azelaic + tretinoin 'glass skin' combo wave (27 viral-tier videos in the feed).
news.her_angle: 'A study just graded glass-skin TikToks — 95% failed. Here's the combo done safely'

news.headline: FDA approves Olumiant (baricitinib) for teens 12+ with severe alopecia areata
news.summary: First JAK inhibitor approved for adolescents with severe AA (BRAVE-AA-PEDS): 42% on 4mg reached ≥80% scalp coverage at 36 weeks vs 5% on placebo. Alopecia Awareness Month peg, and it sits beside your two minoxidil cards; no tracked creator's caption mentions the approval yet.
